title: A whole message fits one interval
hook: A whole message can narrow a single interval.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
Prefix codes, strings, grammar productions and a stack.
doesNotKnow: Refine nested probability intervals to encode a complete message as one final interval.

misconception: Every symbol must receive a whole-number-length bit code independently.
objective: Refine nested probability intervals to encode a complete message as one final interval.

claims.text: Each symbol selects a subinterval of the current interval, not a new interval of the original size. The final bounds retain the whole prefix; decoding also needs the symbol model and a stopping rule such as the known message length.
